context_requirements: Expression of S1PR2 and/or P2RY10 on the cell line
Functional G12/13- or Gi-coupled signaling downstream of the receptor
Serum or lysophospholipid ligands present in the assay medium to provide basal receptor tone
falsifiers: No consistent transcriptional changes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Changes that are equally strong in all lines regardless of S1PR2/P2RY10 expression
A response dominated by generic stress or apoptosis without early immediate-early gene modulation

changes: Moved EGR1, FOS, JUN, CCL2, CXCL2, PTGS2, EDN1, SERPINE1, TRIB1, IER3 from proximal_up to proximal_down: antagonism of a G12/13- or Gi-coupled lysophospholipid receptor reduces, not increases, immediate-early and NF-κB/AP-1 target transcription.

Moved MYC, CCND1, CCNA2, CDK1, AURKA, AURKB, BIRC5, TOP2A, UBE2C, PLK1 from proximal_down to late_down: these are proliferation genes whose transcriptional loss follows G1 arrest, not direct proximal receptor targets.

Moved CDKN1A, GADD45A, TSC22D3, DUSP4, DUSP6, SOCS2, ZFP36, NFKBIA, TNIP1 from late_up to proximal_up: these are immediate-early feedback/attenuation genes induced acutely by loss of tonic G-protein signaling, not late secondary responses.

Moved CCNB1, CCNB2, CDC20, BUB1B, MCM3, PCNA, E2F2 from late_down to proximal_down: these are direct E2F/Myc cell-cycle targets whose transcription falls early when mitogenic receptor signaling is blocked.
Changed kinetics from slow to fast: GPCR antagonist effects on immediate-early and cell-cycle gene transcription occur within 1-6 h, not only at 24 h.
Changed magnitude 6h from weak to moderate and 24h from moderate to weak: the primary transcriptional response to receptor blockade is strongest early and attenuates by 24 h.
Changed line_response HEPG2 from moderate to weak: HepG2 is a hepatoblastoma line with low S1PR2/P2RY10 expression and is not expected to show a strong lysophospholipid-receptor-dependent response.
Changed line_response MCF7 from moderate to weak: MCF7 is ER-positive and less dependent on lysophospholipid-driven G12/13 signaling than mesenchymal lines.
Changed line_response PC3 from weak to moderate: PC3 is a PTEN-null, highly motile prostate cancer line with autocrine lysophospholipid signaling and high S1PR2 expression.
Changed line_response VCAP from weak to moderate: VCaP expresses S1PR2 and has active lysophospholipid-driven AR and MAPK signaling.
Changed line_response A549 from weak to moderate: A549 has functional S1PR2 and P2RY10 and responds to lysophospholipid receptor modulation.
Changed line_response HA1E from none to weak: HA1E is an immortalized normal line with intact GPCR signaling and should show at least a weak response.
Removed generic_effects proliferation_down and g1_arrest: these are generic consequences, not specific proximal effects of lysophospholipid receptor antagonism.
Removed context_requirement for serum or lysophospholipid ligands: the assay medium composition is not specified and basal tone cannot be assumed.
Removed falsifier about generic stress or apoptosis: it is not specific to this mechanism and does not discriminate lysophospholipid receptor antagonism from other perturbations.
Removed evidence list: no citations were provided, so no citation can be verified as supporting the claims.
